description: Cargo stacked shoulder-high along the back wall and lashed under oil-stained tarps: crates, drums, long flat cases the shape of things you don't say out loud. The stencils are painted over, burned off, or in a hand nobody at Buzzard Field will read to you. It came in on a plane. It'll leave on one. In between, it is nobody's, and asking whose is how outsiders stop being welcome.
name: the tarped contraband
